description:
[Taxonomy III.46 — baseline response (public data only)] Inflation-adjusted price comparison across years for a CPT.

WHEN TO USE: User has a historical dollar amount and wants it adjusted for medical-care inflation to a given year.

WHEN NOT: For current market prices (benchmark_payer_rate).

EXAMPLES:
- Adjust $1K 3yr forward at medical CPI: `{"base_amount_usd":1000,"years":3}`
name: inflation_adjusted_price_model
